trust.format: Compact JWS; three base64url components. Verify the signature over ASCII protectedHeader.payload before decoding JSON as UTF-8.
trust.keySource: Official app build configuration assinaturaJwsChavePublica; obterChavePublicaJws returns that build configuration value.
trust.rotation: The official app supports a configured JWKS URL but this production build sets assinaturaJwsJwksUrl to an empty string. No automatic public rotation endpoint is advertised by this build. Pin the reviewed official public JWK; reject unknown kid, wrong algorithm and signature failures. Review a new official app build over HTTPS before changing the pin. Do not accept JWK/jku supplied by untrusted JWS headers.
trust.verificationEvidence: All seven captured signed fixtures passed Node crypto Ed25519 verification. browser-jws-verification.json records a successful browser Web Crypto verification and rejected tampered signing input.

fields.final: tf: official totalizacaoFinal boolean helper accepts s or S only
fields.totalizationDateTime: dt/ht; official app falls back to dg/hg
fields.candidateElected: e: official boolean helper accepts s or S only; never infer election from the vote lead

denominators.candidateShare: v.vv, not v.tv; recompute after summing integer candidate counts and valid-vote denominators.
denominators.countingProgress: s.st / s.ts, not s.sa / s.ts and not an average of locality percentages.
denominators.warning: v.vvc is votosAVotaveisConcorrentes, not a universal substitute for v.vv. The official model uses v.vv when present, falling back to v.vvc for other historical formats. This election publishes v.vv explicitly.

sampleAssertions: Across overall, overseas, SP and overseas locality fixtures, tv = vvc + vb + tvn.
Across these samples, vv equals the sum of candidate vap counts.
Across these samples, ts = st + snt.
Overseas aggregate: ts=1351, st=817, si=776, sa=776; this demonstrates that installed/apuradas are not the total counted-section numerator.
Numeric source counts are decimal strings; percentage source strings use comma decimal separators.

domesticAggregate.status: No separate domestic-only official aggregate was verified.
domesticAggregate.verifiedMetadata: Municipality configuration lists all 26 states, DF and ZZ. The official election discovery uses BR for presidential national scope, and BR result is the overall election scope.
domesticAggregate.implementation: Sum complete 27 domestic UF result feeds, including DF and excluding ZZ. Do not subtract an independently refreshed overseas total from BR.
domesticAggregate.limits: This is a verified absence of an advertised domestic scope in the inspected metadata/app contract, not a claim that no undocumented endpoint can exist.

countryMapping.join: Explicit TRE-DF País/Cidade workbook rows joined to official TSE ZZ locality metadata by accent/punctuation-normalized city name, with six recorded textual aliases. Countries are never guessed from city names.

aliases.30104: TSE MEXICO = TRE-DF Cidade do México
aliases.99333: TSE ST GEORGES DE LOYAPOCK = TRE-DF Saint Georges de Loyapock

countryMapping.classificationCaveat: Keep TRE-DF labels explicit: the electronic-voting workbook labels Caiena as Guiana Francesa, whereas the dispensed-sections workbook labels Saint Georges de Loyapock as França. Do not misrepresent this source classification as an independently verified ISO sovereign-country normalization.

cors.scope: Real browser cross-origin fetch from https://www.tre-df.jus.br to the Chicago overseas locality returned HTTP 200 and response type cors. Captured direct requests with Origin http://localhost:5173 also returned allowing CORS headers.
cors.releaseConstraint: Recheck from the chosen production deployment origin; this observation is not a permanent upstream availability/CORS guarantee.

accessGuidance.observedResponseHeaders: Rate-limit/cache/Retry-After behavior is service-specific. Preserve response headers in official-sources.json.
accessGuidance.limits: No universal access policy or promised client request quota was verified. A build cooldown or server rate-limit header must not be represented as permission to generate that volume. Use lazy loading, bounded concurrency, caching and backoff.
